zones: owner graveyard for the Aftermath half
ordinary hand zone for the other half
stack for the actually cast selected half
objects: uncast spell copy distinguished from actual graveyard casting
state_reads: prospective selected face and printed cost
state_writes: canonical cost payment and stack construction
costs: printed cost of the selected half; other costs and free-cast permissions retain their owners
timing: ordinary instant or sorcery timing of the selected half
graveyard permission adds no timing override
targets: the selected half result owns its normal target schema and revalidation
choices: ordinary private result and replacement choices
hidden_information: private draw/discard continuations remain visible only to the correct principal
apnap: ordinary priority and trigger placement remain unchanged
layers: current stack spell uses only selected-half characteristics; other zones retain combined split values
replacement_effects: mandatory self-exile applies whenever an actually graveyard-cast card leaves the stack, including countering
copy: an uncast spell copy receives no Aftermath leaving-stack replacement
control_change: spell controller changes do not remove actual graveyard cast provenance
zone_change: an external casting permission never overrides the half other-zone prohibition
source_leaves: stack departure commits through the existing zone replacement owner

variants: distinct printed face costs and colors

implementation.supported_slice: Ordinary printed selected-half Aftermath with complete independent result programs, shared face-specific casting authority and canonical leaving-stack exile.

known_blockers: unsupported result bodies or sibling mechanics keep complete cards untrusted
fused split spells and unrepresented acquired keyword producers remain outside the slice
aggregate mechanic trust does not imply universal card or match support
